task: Assess the worker-thread identity cleanup and service effect.
facts: An unprivileged local user can connect to the service named pipe.
The LocalSystem service impersonates the client, rejects the request on one error path, and returns without RevertToSelf.

The poisoned worker thread is reused for mandatory service health and credential-rotation operations, which fail under the retained low-privilege token; the attacker can repeatedly poison every worker and keep the service unavailable until restart.
